analysis.narrative:

· 현재가($0.15)는 SMA5($0.15)와 같고 SMA20($0.16) 하회, 단기 추세 약세 전환 확인
· SMA100($0.21) 및 SMA200($0.20) 대비 큰 폭 하락, 중장기 추세 약세 지속
· 52주 위치 4.2%로 역사적 저점 부근 횡보 구간
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 25.1 → 34.2 (과매도 탈출 시도 중)
· MACD 히스토그램 -0.0011 → 0.0008 (개선 중이나 여전히 약세)
· 볼린저밴드 현재가($0.15)는 하단($0.13)과 중단($0.16) 사이 위치, 하단 접근 구간
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 $0.14 (피벗 S1 레벨 기반)
· 스윙 저항선 $0.18 (볼린저밴드 상단 및 피벗 R1 레벨)
· 5일 저가($0.13)와 20일 저가($0.13) 동일, 횡보 패턴 유지
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 0.80으로 5일 평균 대비 위축, 움직임 신뢰도 하락

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.15) matches SMA5 ($0.15) and is below SMA20 ($0.16), confirming short-term trend shift to weak.
· Significant drop relative to SMA100 ($0.21) and SMA200 ($0.20), indicating continued weak medium-to-long term trend.
· Trading at 4.2% of 52-week range, consolidating near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 25.1 → 34.2 (attempting to exit oversold territory).
· MACD histogram -0.0011 → 0.0008 (improving but still in weak territory).
· Current price ($0.15) is between Bollinger Band lower ($0.13) and middle ($0.16) bands, approaching lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at $0.14 (based on Pivot S1 level).
· Swing resistance at $0.18 (based on Bollinger Band upper band and Pivot R1 level).
· 5-day low ($0.13) and 20-day low ($0.13) are identical, maintaining a sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio at 0.80, below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosed as accumulation; consider buy entry only after RSI recovers above 50 and is accompanied by increased volume.
